name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
description: Founded in 1859 on the edge of Orchard Road, this 82-hectare tropical garden is a green oasis in central Singapore. Its research on rubber cultivation helped fuel a regional boom, and its National Orchid Garden now shows off about 1,200 species and 2,000 hybrids, some named for visiting dignitaries. Today it draws around 4.5 million visitors a year.
